neighbours.label: A measure/kind/part head noun right before an expected 'of' (what kind, the number, a piece, the remainder, next round), or a wh-word plus noun asking which sort/level/side; the slot where a partitive 'of' is about to come.

After the storm, the remainder of the village was cut off from the main road for three days.
Nobody could tell me which level of difficulty the second boss was designed for, so I guessed.
She stared at the last bit of the map, wondering what type of terrain lay beyond the ridge.
Talks will resume next month, and officials expect a final round of negotiations before the deadline.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations sit on nouns like kind/type/level/side/round/number/piece/remainder/century that head a 'X of' phrase or follow what/which; the neg pole is the quantity/count side (fewer, number, few). Pole is broad (1.2% of tokens above 0.1 max), so near misses may fire weakly; the census profession result is unexplained.
